title: Sport
about: Collocations for talking about sport: which sports go with do, play and go, winning and losing (train hard, set a record, fierce competition), and football (score a goal, take a penalty, take the lead).

parts.title: Common mistakes
parts.note: Українське «займатися» і «грати» англійською передають різними дієсловами. Do — переважно для занять без м'яча, які не є грою (йога, гімнастика, бойові мистецтва), а також для вправ і занять: do exercises, do activities. Play — для ігор, де суперники змагаються: футбол, теніс, шахи, карти, комп'ютерні ігри. Go — для занять на -ing: go swimming, go skiing. Make зі спортом майже не вживається. Practise — відпрацьовувати конкретну навичку (practise your serve), а тренуватися загалом — train. У таблиці — помилки з рамки Common mistakes і ще кілька пасток, типових для українців.

rows: make a game / play a party of chess
have / play a game of chess
play in football / play the football

items.pattern: do + gymnastics / judo / karate / weightlifting / aerobics / yoga / wrestling / circuit training / archery / athletics
items.meaning: take part regularly in a sport or exercise activity, usually one that is not a game played with a ball
items.example: My daughter **does gymnastics** three times a week after school.
more: I started **doing yoga** to help with my back pain.
At university he **did weightlifting** and could lift twice his own weight.
items.watchOut: «Займатися йогою, дзюдо» — do yoga, do judo, а не make yoga і не play judo: play — для ігор з м'ячем, карт, шахів. Про йогу й бойові мистецтва кажуть також practise yoga / karate.

items.pattern: play + game, no article · badminton / billiards / hockey / bowls / rugby / golf / (table) tennis / cricket / baseball / chess / darts / cards / dominoes
items.meaning: take part in a game or a sport where players or teams try to beat each other
items.example: We **play badminton** in the school hall every Thursday evening.
more: Grandad taught me to **play chess** when I was seven.
On rainy afternoons at the cottage we **played cards** and darts.
items.watchOut: «Грати у футбол / в шахи» — play football, play chess: без in і без the. The ставлять перед музичним інструментом (play the guitar), а не перед грою: play tennis, не play the tennis.

items.pattern: go + -ing · fishing / skiing / bowling / cycling / skateboarding / surfing / snowboarding / hang-gliding / climbing / hill walking / sailing / jogging / swimming · go – went – gone / been
items.meaning: do an activity, often outdoors or away from home, usually for fun
items.uk: ходити плавати / кататися на лижах / на рибалку
items.example: Every January we **go skiing** in the mountains with my cousins.
more: We **went swimming** in the sea every day on holiday.
My dad and my uncle **go fishing** at the lake on Sunday mornings.
items.watchOut: «Кататися на лижах» — go skiing, а не make skiing чи ride on skis. «Піти на рибалку» — go fishing, одразу -ing без прийменника: не go to fishing. Go on fishing означає «продовжувати рибалити». «Я був на рибалці» — I've been fishing.

items.pattern: go to + activity, no article · go to aerobics / judo / yoga / karate · = go to a class
items.meaning: regularly attend a class in this activity
items.example: I **go to yoga** straight after work on Wednesdays, so I can't meet then.
more: My son **goes to karate** at the sports centre.
She started **going to aerobics** to meet people after moving to a new town.
items.watchOut: Go to yoga — ходити на заняття з йоги; do yoga — займатися йогою взагалі, хоч і вдома. Артикль тут не потрібен: go to judo, а не go to the judo (але go to a judo class).

items.pattern: do / play (a lot of / some / no) sport · sport is usually uncountable in British English (US: sports)
items.meaning: take part in sport in general
items.example: My brother **does a lot of sport**: football, tennis and swimming.
more: Do you **play any sport**, or do you just watch it on TV?
Our school wants every child to **do some sport** every day.
items.watchOut: «Займатися спортом» — do sport або play sport, а не make sport. Practise sport зазвичай теж звучить неприродно: practise — відпрацьовувати конкретне вміння. У британській англійській sport зазвичай незлічуване: I don't do much sport.

items.pattern: do (stretching / breathing / warm-up) exercises · do sit-ups / press-ups
items.meaning: do a set of particular movements to make your body stronger or more flexible
items.example: Grandma **does exercises** for her knees every morning before breakfast.
more: I **do breathing exercises** when I feel nervous before an exam.
In PE we **did exercises** with a ball and a skipping rope.
items.watchOut: «Робити вправи» — do exercises, не make exercises. Exercises (з -s) — окремі вправи; exercise без -s — фізичне навантаження загалом: I need more exercise.

items.pattern: play computer / video / board / card games · play a game
items.meaning: spend time playing games on a screen or on a table, for fun
items.example: The kids **play board games** with their grandparents every Sunday afternoon.
more: We **played video games** all weekend while it rained.
My nephew **plays computer games** with friends from all over the world.
items.watchOut: Ігри — play games, а не do games. Make a game — створити гру. «Грати в ігри» — без in: play computer games, не play in computer games.

items.phrase: have / play a game of cards
items.pattern: have / play a game of cards / chess / tennis / football · have a quick game
items.meaning: play one game of something, often just for fun
items.example: After dinner we **had a game of cards**, and Grandma won again.
more: We **had a quick game of tennis** before lunch.
Two old men **play a game of chess** in the park every afternoon.
items.watchOut: «Зіграти партію» — have / play a game of…, а не make a game і не play a party: party — це вечірка. Після game of назва гри без артикля: a game of chess.

items.pattern: do (lots of / different / outdoor) activities · take part in activities
items.meaning: take part in things organised for fun, sport or learning
items.uk: брати участь у різних заняттях і розвагах
items.example: At the summer camp the children **do activities** like canoeing and rock climbing.
more: We **did lots of fun activities** on the team-building day.
If you **do outdoor activities** in winter, wear several thin layers.
items.watchOut: Activities — do activities або take part in activities, а не make activities і не practise activities. Activity часто краще перекладати не «активність», а «заняття, розваги».

items.pattern: practise sth / practise doing sth · practise your serve / swing / taking penalties · = train · practise (verb, UK), practice (noun)
items.meaning: do something again and again in order to get better at it
items.example: He went to the driving range to **practise his golf swing**.
more: The young players **practise taking free kicks** for an hour after school.
She spends every lunch break on the court **practising her backhand**.
items.watchOut: Practise — не «займатися спортом» загалом, а відпрацьовувати конкретну навичку: practise your backhand. У британській англійській дієслово пишуть practise (з s), іменник — practice (з c): football practice. «Займатися спортом» — do sport.

items.pattern: win / lose a match / game / race / competition · win – won – won · lose – lost – lost · but beat a team / a player
items.meaning: finish a game or competition as the winner or the loser
items.example: Our village team **won the match** 3–1, and everyone went to the pub to celebrate.
more: We **lost the match**, but we played much better than last week.
She has **won** every race she's entered this year.
items.watchOut: Win — виграти матч, гру, приз: win a match. Перемогти суперника — beat: We beat Italy, а не We won Italy. «Програти комусь» — lose to sb: We lost to Italy. Не плутай lose (програти, загубити) і loose (вільний, широкий).

items.pattern: (really / thoroughly) deserve to win / lose · deserve the win
items.meaning: play well enough that winning would be fair
items.example: After all those months of training, she really **deserved to win** the gold medal.
more: Both teams played brilliantly, and neither **deserved to lose**.
It was a lucky goal. We didn't **deserve to win** today.
items.watchOut: «Заслуговувати на перемогу» — deserve to win або deserve the win, без on і of: не deserve on winning. Achieve to win — помилка: achieve не вживається з to + дієслово.

items.pattern: be narrowly defeated / beaten (by sb) · narrowly win / lose / miss sth
items.meaning: lose by a very small amount, so the winner only just won
items.uk: ледь-ледь програти, програти з мінімальною різницею
items.example: We were **narrowly beaten** by the team that went on to win the whole tournament.
more: The champion was **narrowly defeated** in the semi-final after a five-hour match.
The relay team **narrowly lost** to Jamaica by a hundredth of a second.
items.watchOut: Narrowly тут не «вузько», а «ледь-ледь, з мінімальною різницею». «Програли з мінімальним рахунком» — were narrowly beaten або narrowly lost, а не were closely beaten. Протилежне — heavily / easily beaten.

items.phrase: go in for / enter a competition
items.pattern: go in for / enter a competition / race / contest · enter sth (no preposition) · take part in a competition
items.meaning: put your name down to take part in a competition
items.uk: взяти участь у змаганнях, записатися на змагання
items.example: Twenty schools **went in for the swimming competition** this year.
more: To **enter the competition**, just fill in the form on our website.
I'm thinking of **entering the town's fun run** next spring.
items.watchOut: Enter a competition — зазвичай без прийменника: не enter in / into a competition. З прийменником in — take part in a competition або participate in a competition.

items.pattern: train hard / regularly / every day · train for a race / match · hard (not hardly)
items.meaning: practise and exercise a lot to get ready for a sports event
items.example: She's been **training hard** for the marathon since January.
more: The whole squad **trained hard** all summer for the new season.
The whole family **trains hard** for the village fun run every year.
items.watchOut: «Багато тренуватися» — train hard, не train strongly і не train much. Hard тут — прислівник «наполегливо», без -ly: hardly означає «ледве» (I hardly trained — я майже не тренувався).

items.pattern: attend / do / have a training session · (five) training sessions a week · training is uncountable
items.meaning: take part in an organised time of practice for a sport
items.example: The players **attend two training sessions** a day before a big tournament.
more: I missed Tuesday's **training session** because I had a cold.
He **does a training session** in the gym before work every morning.
items.watchOut: «Відвідувати тренування» — attend training sessions, а не visit trainings. Training незлічуване, тому «тренування» в множині — training sessions. Не плутай attend (відвідувати) і assist (допомагати).

items.pattern: put up a (good / brave / real) fight · not put up much of a fight · put – put – put
items.meaning: try hard to win or not to be beaten, even when it's difficult
items.example: Nobody expected much from the little club, but they **put up a good fight** against the champions.
more: Our tennis player lost in three sets, but she **put up a brave fight**.
The team **didn't put up much of a fight** and lost 5–0.
items.watchOut: «Гідно боролися» — put up a good fight, а не made a good fight. Fight тут не бійка, а боротьба за перемогу.

items.phrase: gain / get a place in the next round
items.pattern: gain / get a place in the next stage / round (of the competition) · in the final / in the team · go through to the next round
items.meaning: win the right to continue to the next part of a competition
items.example: With a goal in the last minute, our team **gained a place in the next round**.
more: Only the top three runners **get a place in the final**.
Thousands of young players dream of **getting a place in** a professional team.
items.watchOut: «Вийти в наступний раунд» — get / gain a place in the next round або go through to the next round. Go out — навпаки, «вибути»: We went out in the first round. «Етап змагань» — stage, а не step.

items.pattern: break / beat / smash the (world / national) record · break – broke – broken
items.meaning: do better than the best result ever achieved
items.example: The young runner **broke the world record** by almost three seconds.
more: My grandad likes to say he once **broke the school record** for the high jump.
If she swims this fast tomorrow, she could **beat the record**.
items.watchOut: «Побити рекорд» — break / beat a record, а не hit a record чи kill a record. Break тут не «зламати», а «перевершити».

items.pattern: set a (new / world / national) record · set – set – set · become a (world) record holder
items.meaning: achieve a result that becomes the new best ever; the person who has it is the record holder
items.example: She **set a new world record** in the 400 metres and became the first **world record holder** from her country.
more: The swimmer **set three national records** in one weekend.
He's been the British **record holder** in the long jump for ten years.
items.watchOut: «Встановити рекорд» — set a record, а не put / install a record. Make a record — записати платівку чи пісню. «Рекордсмен» — a record holder: слова recordsman в англійській немає.

items.pattern: come up against sb / sth · come up against a strong team / fierce competition / a problem · come – came – come
items.meaning: have to play against a strong opponent or deal with a difficult situation
items.example: In the quarter-final we **came up against** the best team in the league.
more: When she opened her café, she **came up against** a lot of problems with the council.
You'll **come up against** stronger players when you move up to the senior team.
items.watchOut: «Зіткнутися з» — come up against або face, причому face без with: We faced a strong team. Come across — це інше: випадково натрапити. Come up with — придумати.

items.pattern: fierce / intense / stiff competition (for sth) · face / come up against fierce competition
items.meaning: very strong competition, where many people try hard to win
items.example: Our little sports shop faces **fierce competition** from the big online stores.
more: The young skater will face **intense competition** at her first international event.
There was **intense competition** between the two brothers, on and off the pitch.
items.watchOut: «Жорстка конкуренція» — fierce / intense / stiff competition. Cruel competition (від «жорстокий») і hard competition звучать неприродно. Fierce вимовляється одним складом.

items.pattern: achieve / fulfil / realise your ambition(s) · an ambition to do sth / of doing sth
items.meaning: succeed in doing what you have wanted to do for a long time
items.example: She **achieved her ambition** of running a marathon before she turned forty.
more: Hard work helped him **achieve his ambitions** both on and off the pitch.
My uncle finally **realised his ambition** to climb Kilimanjaro.
items.watchOut: «Здійснити мрію» про велику мету — achieve / fulfil / realise your ambition, а не make your ambition. Ambition в англійській — нейтральне або добре слово: «заповітна мета», а не «гонор», як інколи «амбіції» в українській.

items.pattern: achieve / set / run a personal best (PB) · beat your personal best
items.meaning: get your own best result ever, even if you don't win
items.example: I didn't win the race, but I **achieved a personal best** by over a minute.
more: Five swimmers from our club **set personal bests** at the weekend.
Runners who **achieve a personal best** get a free T-shirt from the club.
items.watchOut: «Особистий рекорд» — a personal best (скорочено PB). Personal record — переважно американський варіант. Не personal top і не personal maximum.

items.pattern: desperately want / need sth / to do sth · be desperate to win / for sth
items.meaning: want something very, very much
items.example: Both teams **desperately wanted to win**, so the match was very tense.
more: Our dog **desperately wants** to play every time I pick up the ball.
She's **desperate to** make the Olympic team this time.
items.watchOut: Desperately тут не «у відчаї», а «дуже сильно»: I desperately want a holiday — мені страшенно хочеться у відпустку. Зазвичай desperately стоїть перед want: they desperately wanted to win.

items.pattern: enhance / improve your performance · take drugs to enhance performance · performance-enhancing drugs
items.meaning: make your results better, sometimes unfairly with drugs
items.example: Some cyclists took banned drugs to **enhance their performance**.
more: Good running shoes won't **enhance your performance** much, but they'll protect your knees.
Tests for **performance-enhancing** drugs are now much more accurate.
items.watchOut: Performance у спорті — не «вистава», а «результат, гра, виступ»: Her performance was excellent. Enhance — формальне слово; у розмові частіше improve.

items.pattern: fail / pass / take a drugs test · US: a drug test
items.meaning: be found, after a test, to have taken drugs that are not allowed
items.example: Three riders were banned from the race after they **failed a drugs test**.
more: She has never **failed a drugs test** in fifteen years of competing.
Players can be asked to **take a drugs test** at any time, even on holiday.
items.watchOut: «Не пройти тест» — fail a test, а не fall a test і не lose a test. Британською — a drugs test, американською — a drug test; кажуть і a doping test.

items.pattern: play / have a (football) match · play / have a game (of football) · play a match against sb
items.meaning: take part in a game of football or another team sport
items.example: We **played a match** against the teachers on the last day of term.
more: The two villages **have a football match** every Boxing Day.
We **have a game** every Sunday morning in the park, if anyone wants to join.
items.watchOut: «Зіграти матч» — play / have a match, а не make / do a match. Hold a match кажуть про організаторів: The match will be held on Sunday.

items.pattern: a home / an away match / game · play at home / away · on your (team's) home ground
items.meaning: a match played at your own team's ground, or at the other team's ground
items.uk: домашній матч / матч на виїзді; рідний стадіон
items.example: We've got an **away match** in Leeds on Saturday, so the coach leaves at eight.
more: Tickets for **home matches** are cheaper if you're a member.
United haven't lost on their **home ground** for over a year.
items.watchOut: «Матч на виїзді» — an away match, а не an outside match чи a guest match. «Рідний стадіон» — home ground (UK) або home stadium.

items.pattern: score a goal / a penalty / points · score the winning goal · score twice
items.meaning: get the ball into the net so your team gets a point
items.example: My little brother **scored his first goal** for the school team today.
more: Nobody **scored** in the first half, so it was 0–0 at half-time.
The winning **goal was scored** by a sixteen-year-old.
items.watchOut: «Забити гол» — score a goal, а не hit a goal чи make a goal. «Ворота» — the goal, а не the gates: The ball went into the goal.

items.pattern: tackle an opponent / a player · make a tackle · a hard / clean tackle
items.meaning: try to take the ball away from a player on the other team
items.example: It takes courage to **tackle an opponent** who's twice your size.
more: Our captain is brilliant at **tackling** and hardly ever gives away a foul.
She **tackled** the striker just before he could shoot.
items.watchOut: Tackle у футболі — відібрати м'яч, часто в підкаті. «Суперник» у грі — opponent, а не enemy. В іншому значенні tackle a problem — взятися за розв'язання проблеми.

items.pattern: take / gain / win possession (of the ball) · keep / lose possession · no article before possession
items.meaning: get the ball and control it
items.example: Our midfielder **took possession of the ball** and ran half the length of the pitch.
more: The team that **keeps possession** longer usually wins.
They **lost possession** in their own half, and the other team scored.
items.watchOut: «Заволодіти м'ячем» — take / gain possession of the ball, без артикля перед possession: не take the possession. Possession — «володіння», не плутай з position (позиція).

items.pattern: foul sb · commit a foul (on sb) · a foul · a clear / bad foul
items.meaning: touch or stop another player in a way that is against the rules
items.example: The referee showed him a yellow card for **fouling an opponent**.
more: Our captain never **fouls** anyone; he's the fairest player in the league.
That was a clear **foul**, so why didn't the referee stop the game?
items.watchOut: «Сфолити на комусь» — foul sb, без on: He fouled the goalkeeper. On ставлять після іменника: a foul on the goalkeeper. Foul звучить як fowl, а не як fool.

items.pattern: the referee blows the / his / her whistle · blow the final whistle · blow – blew – blown
items.meaning: make a sound with a whistle to stop or start the game
items.example: The game was so dirty that the referee **blew his whistle** every two minutes.
more: Keep running until you hear the coach **blow the whistle**.
The fans went wild when the referee **blew the final whistle**.
items.watchOut: «Суддя дав свисток» — the referee blew the whistle (або whistled), а не gave a whistle. Blow — неправильне дієслово: blew, blown, не blowed.

items.phrase: take a penalty / a free kick
items.pattern: take a penalty / a free kick / a corner · score / miss a penalty · win / award a penalty
items.meaning: kick the ball to restart the game after the other team has broken the rules
items.example: Our captain **took the penalty** and put it in the top corner.
more: Who's going to **take the free kick**?
He **took a free kick** from thirty metres and hit the bar.
items.watchOut: «Бити пенальті» — take a penalty, а не beat a penalty (калька з «бити»). Score a penalty — забити пенальті, miss a penalty — не забити. «Штрафний удар» — a free kick.

items.pattern: drop sb (from the team / the side) · be dropped
items.meaning: decide not to put a player in the team for the next game
items.uk: не включити гравця до складу, вивести з основного складу
items.example: After three bad games in a row, the striker **was dropped from the team**.
more: If you don't train, you'll be **dropped**. It's as simple as that.
She was **dropped** from the national team after a poor season.
items.watchOut: Drop тут не «впустити», а «не взяти до складу на наступну гру». Не плутай із send sb off — вилучити гравця з поля під час гри (червона картка).

items.pattern: bring on a substitute · bring sb on · come on as a substitute · a sub (informal)
items.meaning: replace one player with another during a game
items.example: In the second half the manager **brought on a substitute** to give the team more energy.
more: She **came on as a substitute** in the last game of the season.
Our coach **brought** me **on** for the last ten minutes.
items.watchOut: «Випустити запасного» — bring on a substitute (або make a substitution), а не release чи let out a substitute. Substitute — сам запасний гравець (у розмові a sub), substitution — заміна.

items.pattern: take the lead · be in the lead · take a 2–0 lead
items.meaning: go in front in a game, so you are winning
items.example: City **took the lead** after ten minutes, but United equalised just before half-time.
more: We were **in the lead** for most of the race, but we finished second.
The visitors **took a 2–0 lead** with two quick goals.
items.watchOut: «Повести в рахунку» — take the lead (або go ahead), а не take the leadership: leadership — це керівництво, лідерство в компанії чи країні. Бути попереду — be in the lead.

warmup.explain: Займатися спортом — do sport (або play sport). Make sport — калька.

warmup.uk: Минулої зими ми їздили кататися на лижах у Карпати.
warmup.q: Last winter we ___ skiing in the Carpathians.
warmup.explain: Кататися на лижах — go skiing: go + форма на -ing.
Зіграти партію — have (або play) a game of… Make a game — створити гру.
Перемогти суперника — beat sb. Win — виграти матч чи приз: we won the match.
Побити рекорд — break (або beat) a record.

warmup.q: My brother is going to ___ the penalty.
warmup.explain: Бити пенальті — take a penalty. Забити пенальті — score a penalty.

A.q: My uncle ___ archery at weekends, and he's really good at it.
A.explain: Стрільба з лука, гімнастика, йога — do. Play — для ігор (теніс, шахи), go — для занять на -ing (go swimming).

A.q: The coach made us ___ some warm-up exercises before the match.
A.explain: Робити вправи — do exercises. Make exercises — калька з «робити».

A.q: Before every game, our best player ___ his shooting for an hour.

example.title: So close
example.uk:
Наша сільська футбольна команда наполегливо тренувалася весь сезон, і нарешті ми вийшли у фінал. У день фіналу ми зіткнулися з набагато більшим клубом, тож ніхто не чекав, що ми виграємо матч.

На двадцятій хвилині наш капітан заволодів м'ячем у центрі поля й побіг уперед у штрафний майданчик. Захисник порушив на ньому правила, і суддя дав свисток — пенальті. Мій брат пробив пенальті й забив, тож ми повели в рахунку.

У другому таймі вони випустили запасного гравця, який забив двічі. Ми гідно боролися, але ледь-ледь програли — 1:2. І все ж усі погодилися, що ми заслуговували на перемогу.

In the second half they [[brought on a substitute|c10]] who [[scored|c3]] twice. We [[put up a good fight|b7]], but we were [[narrowly beaten|b3]], 2–1. Still, everyone agreed we had [[deserved to win|b2]].
